description: This file handles markdown content processing, including parsing, validation, frontmatter extraction, and error handling for documentation and blog content in a project. It also defines related types and custom error classes.

classes.name: MarkdocValidationFailure
classes.description: Custom error class for handling validation failures during Markdoc content processing.

methods.name: printValidationError
methods.description: Formats and returns a string describing a validation error with location info.

methods.name: readBlogContent
methods.description: Reads a blog markdown file, extracts frontmatter, and transforms content into a Tag.

methods.name: readDocsContent
methods.description: Reads a documentation markdown file, extracts frontmatter, and transforms content into a Tag.

methods.name: transformContent
methods.description: Parses, validates, and transforms markdown content into a renderable Tag object.

methods.name: extractDocsFrontmatter
methods.description: Extracts and validates the frontmatter (title and description) from documentation content.

methods.name: extractBlogFrontmatter
methods.description: Extracts and validates the frontmatter (including publishDate, author, etc.) from blog content.
